mechanism: Primidone induces CYP3A4 and other hepatic enzymes, potentially increasing bumetanide metabolism and reducing its diuretic efficacy; additionally, both drugs can contribute to electrolyte abnormalities and volume depletion.
action: Monitor diuretic response and serum electrolytes (particularly potassium) more frequently; adjust bumetanide dosing if needed based on clinical response and fluid/electrolyte status.
